explication: Image Toolbox is an Android image-editing and utility app. Its principal user workflow is selecting or capturing media, applying an editing or utility operation, then saving or sharing the result. The README documents editing, filters, EXIF changes, background removal, and AI enhancement; the tree also shows distinct tools for OCR, PDF, archives, and more. The supplied excerpts expose selected runtime links, including screenshot capture, compression, and file handling. Other feature connections are shown as unverified where their implementation was not sampled.
